In the staged witness the payload bytes at offsets 71-72 are `07 0f`, so `ot::Tlv::Get()` first reads a header with type `kMeshLocalPrefix` and length 15, then re-reads only `sizeof(meshLocalPrefix) == 10` bytes total.
